content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom operator billing and customer management software and outsourced operations, not network security hardware or security software sold to enterprises."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Government consulting and technology services firm; it sells staff and contracts rather than security hardware, switches or firewalls."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Payment and banknote validation equipment for retailers and central banks, with no network security or networking products."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Diversified maker of filtration, utility meters, test equipment and aerospace parts, with no network security business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Government engineering and systems-integration contractor; its cybersecurity work is services-led, not network security products."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Application development and data platform software for IT teams; it lacks firewalls, network hardware and threat-protection products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Telecom voice and IP communications equipment and software; its security line is session border control, not Fortinet's network security portfolio."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Physical cash-in-transit, ATM services and armored logistics, a service business unrelated to network security products."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Cloud work management and content software for business users; it lacks network security hardware and threat protection."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Network test, measurement and optical component maker; it tests networks rather than securing them with firewalls or security subscriptions."}]}
